ValidationRule.description: Kickoff must lie between 7 days before 00:00:00 on the start date and 23:59:59 on the end date; completed projects must have enough elapsed hours.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(ISBLANK(Start_Date__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(End_Date__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(Kickoff_At__c)), OR( Kickoff_At__c < DATETIMEVALUE(TEXT(Start_Date__c) & ' 00:00:00') - 7, Kickoff_At__c > DATETIMEVALUE(TEXT(End_Date__c) & ' 23:59:59'), AND( ISPICKVAL(Status__c, 'Completed'), FLOOR((NOW() - Kickoff_At__c) * 24) < ROUND(NULLVALUE(Duration_Secs__c, 0) / 3600, 0) ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Kickoff At is outside the project window or too recent for a completed project.
